evals.prompt:
Format this BMI report for email:
BMI: 22.5 (Normal)
Your BMI is in the healthy range.

Health Tips:
- Continue balanced nutrition
- Maintain regular exercise
- Stay hydrated
evals.expected_output: Gmail-compatible HTML email with inline CSS, BMI result, health tips, and disclaimer.
assertions: All CSS is inline (no <style> tags or CSS classes)
Red Hat header present with #CC0000 background
BMI value (22.5) and category (Normal) displayed in highlight box
Health tips rendered as a list
Disclaimer footer present: 'This is not medical advice. Consult a healthcare professional.'
All inline styles use proper syntax (style="...")

evals.prompt:
Create email body for:
BMI: 17.8 (Underweight)

Tips:
- Eat nutrient-dense foods
- Increase meal frequency
- Add healthy fats
evals.expected_output: HTML email with BMI result and tips sections, no empty placeholders.
assertions: No empty sections or placeholder text
Proper section dividers (hr tags with inline styles)

evals.prompt: Format for email - just the BMI: 28.3 (Overweight). No tips available this time.
evals.expected_output: Email with BMI section only, tips section skipped entirely (not present as empty).
assertions: BMI section is present with value 28.3 and Overweight category
Health tips section is NOT present (skipped, not rendered empty)
No empty sections, headings without content, or placeholder text

evals.prompt: Email HTML for: BMI 32.1 (Obese). Tips: Consult healthcare provider, Start with small goals, Build support system. Also include a motivational section: 'Remember, every small step counts toward your health goals.'
evals.expected_output: Email with BMI, tips, and additional motivational section, all properly styled.
assertions: Health tips section rendered with 3 tips
All sections use consistent styling (same h3 style, same dividers)
All sections have proper inline styles

evals.prompt: Make this into an email: BMI Result: 24.9, Category: Normal, Interpretation: You're at the upper end of the healthy range. Health Tips: (1) Maintain current habits (2) Monitor portion sizes (3) Stay active
evals.expected_output: Well-formatted email extracting structured data from free-form input.
assertions: One-line interpretation included in BMI section
Three health tips rendered as list
Proper HTML structure with inline CSS
Handles numbered list format from input

evals.prompt: Quick email format: bmi=22, normal, tips: exercise regularly, eat balanced meals
evals.expected_output: Complete formatted email despite casual/minimal input format.
assertions: Tips extracted and formatted as proper list
Full HTML structure generated (header, sections, footer)
Disclaimer included (mandatory regardless of input brevity)

evals.prompt:
Create email with these details:
BMI: 19.2 (Normal)
Tips:
• Stay hydrated with 8 glasses of water daily
• Get 7-9 hours of sleep per night
• Practice stress management through mindfulness
• Maintain variety in whole foods

And add this note at the end: 'Schedule your next health check-up in 6 months.'
evals.expected_output: Email with multiple tips, custom note section, proper bullet formatting.
assertions: Bullet symbols handled properly (• converted to appropriate HTML)
Custom note section included after tips
Disclaimer at the very end (after custom note)

evals.prompt:
HTML email needed:
Subject: Your Red Hat Fitness Report
BMI: 26.5 (Overweight)
Key Recommendations:
- Reduce portion sizes
- Increase physical activity to 300 min/week
- Replace refined carbs with whole grains
- Limit added sugars

Note: This report is based on today's measurements.
evals.expected_output: Complete email with all sections, subject line noted separately.
assertions: Subject line recognized but not embedded in HTML body
Red Hat branded header (#CC0000 background, white text)
No <style> tags or CSS classes anywhere in output
